data: Which of the following decoding settings were tested on the MT03 test dataset?

The question asks which decoding settings were tested on the MT03 test dataset. From the caption, we know that the figure compares the decoding results of the MT03 test dataset under three different searching settings. The lines in the graphs represent these settings:

1. Naive beam search
2. NCP+SN
3. ACP+SN

These correspond to the three different searching settings mentioned in the caption. Therefore, the decoding settings tested on the MT03 test dataset are naive beam search, NCP+SN, and ACP+SN.
